name: jide
description: JIDE — 自测闭环优先的轻量 Agentic IDE(Electrobun + React + pi 内核)

scripts.desktop:prepare: cd apps/desktop && DASH_RELEASE_OFFLINE=1 hutch electrobun prepare
scripts.desktop:dev: cd apps/desktop && DASH_RELEASE_OFFLINE=1 hutch electrobun dev
scripts.desktop:build: cd apps/desktop && bunx vite build && DASH_RELEASE_OFFLINE=1 hutch electrobun build
scripts.desktop: bun run desktop:view && bun run desktop:dev
